scope: Isaac Sim4.5 actual Nova Carter static mount admission; no loaded motion, sensor FOV, mount strength or industrial rating qualification

host.closure_scope: gated worker and descendants contained in an owned Windows Job Object

native_result.scope: one free Nova Carter, chassis-fixed carrier and separate free dynamic loaded tote; static admission only
profile_assumptions_verbatim: Carter static candidate v2: chassis-local deck height derives from measured118 chassis collision AABB top plus an authored2mm mounting gap, existing post height and deck half thickness. This AABB is not a mechanical surface or strength certificate.
Original generic bolted-deck/raised-support candidate, not a manufacturer model, certified payload or finished low-profile lifting AMR.
All dimensions, masses, uniform material distributions, friction and contact settings are authored development assumptions, not measurements.

Nova Carter remains the development base. Declared keepouts below are candidate integration constraints, not its measured collider/sensor geometry. Actual robot-frame transform, body/sensor clearance, mount strength, added inertia and navigation footprint need native admission before installation.
Existing presentation-only cargo is independent. This profile does not change a registry, scene, map, footprint, controller or sensor.

Probe uses fixed stand pads instead of a robot chassis. Carrier and tote are separate dynamic compound bodies; centred ballast is rigidly included in tote inertia, not loose contents. Separation is an authored upward velocity impulse, not a lift actuator or unloading operation.
native_result.fixture_scope_difference: Original profile stand/release wording describes 114 only. This fixture uses a free Nova Carter and chassis fixed joint, no stands and no authored separation. Geometry/mass/material assumptions remain unchanged.

native_geometry.source: geometry-computed local extents transformed by native XformCache before stepping; not cooked hull, ray visibility or mount strength
native_geometry.sensor_keepout_source: authored 0.16m cube around measured camera/lidar frame candidates; lidar name matches are conservative anchors, not proof of a functioning sensor or FOV

admission.scope: composed collision AABB/frame admission only; authored sensor housing boxes, no FOV or mount strength proof

attachment.policy: external fixed constraint as installed RobotAssembler; no global collision mask, no world anchor or articulation topology change

native_result.velocity_source: native PhysX rigid-body and wheel joint reads, not ROS odometry
native_result.control_policy: zero wheel velocity targets only; no position/velocity state setters, world anchor, GT driving or tolerance changes
